definitions.response_rate_pct: Applications currently at screening, assessment, interview, offer, rejected or withdrawn divided by non-saved applications. This is a tracker-stage proxy, not an employer response-time metric.
definitions.interview_rate_pct: Applications currently at interview or offer divided by non-saved applications.
definitions.offer_rate_pct: Applications currently at offer divided by non-saved applications.
definitions.cv_versions: Descriptive counts only. CV groups are not randomized or adjusted for role mix, timing or applicant differences.

limitations: Small, self-entered samples are unstable and may be incomplete.
Current stage is a snapshot; stage history and time-to-response are not modelled.
CV-version comparisons are observational and do not establish that a CV caused an outcome.
No personal data, employer legitimacy or vacancy authenticity is verified.
